name: DreamFusion
definition: A text-to-3D generation method that optimizes a NeRF to render images with high scores from a text-to-image diffusion model, requiring no 3D training data.
summary: DreamFusion generates 3D NeRFs from text using Score Distillation Sampling to distill 2D diffusion priors, distinguishing itself by creating scenes from scratch without 3D training data.
